rows.label: qst640403_msg0001
rows.name: Those girls... What's wrong?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0002
rows.name: They all look terribly troubled.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0101
rows.name: Very good. Let us inquire!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0102
rows.name:
Rinne... Didn't we come
here for the springs?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0103
rows.name:
I can't enjoy the hot springs while
girls here are in trouble!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0104
rows.name:
That's just like you, Rinne-san. I
agree.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0105
rows.name: I can't ignore someone who's unhappy.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0106
rows.name:
You girls look troubled. Tell me
what's going on.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0107
rows.name: Who are you...?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0108
rows.name:
Oh, we're just some kindly Blades
passing by with their Drivers.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0109
rows.name:
...Is it really okay to talk to
someone bathing in a floating tub?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0110
rows.name: I don't know...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0111
rows.name:
If she's always in the bath, maybe
she's an expert, mo?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0112
rows.name: True...!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0113
rows.name: Pfft...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0114
rows.name: ...Just tell us.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0115
rows.name:
Uhm... Okay. It's our fathers.
They've not come back from the
Geothermal Mining Plant.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0116
rows.name:
The hot springs in town aren't working
right, so we think something may have
happened at the plant.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0117
rows.name: That is worrying...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0118
rows.name:
So we can't use the hot springs right
now?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0119
rows.name:
You can, but they're not at their
best...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0120
rows.name:
We want to go check right away, but
the road is really dangerous, mo...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0121
rows.name:
Such foul mouths, yet such devoted
girls...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0122
rows.name: I'm moved!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0123
rows.name:
I'll solve your problem with the
Driver over there.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0124
rows.name: Really?!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0125
rows.name:
If it means getting the hot springs
back to their best, we should spare no
effort.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0126
rows.name: In that case, please help us, mo.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0127
rows.name:
Our fathers work at the Geothermal
Mining Plant.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0128
rows.name:
Someone's father should be by the
entrance, mo.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0129
rows.name:
Please wait here. We'll be sure to
bring you good news.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0130
rows.name:
When Kasane says that, I get a bad
feeling...

rows.label: qst640403_msg0201
rows.name:
Zakuro, you must go
speak to the girls.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0202
rows.name:
Whaaat...? I thought we were
here for the hot springs!

rows.label: qst640403_msg0203
rows.name:
I don't wanna. Just
go yourself, Rinne.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0204
rows.name:
We would, but uh, somehow... we're
not really feeling it right now.

rows.label: qst640403_msg0205
rows.name: ...Okay, so now what?

rows.label: qst640403_msg0206
rows.name: Mgghhh...
